title: Muse Assistant: Why Was My Payment Declined?
tagline: Get calm, clear answers about your payments in plain words you can trust.
audience: Cash App, Chime and prepaid users who want simple, learner-friendly help understanding declines.
objectives: Explain in your own words why a payment was declined
Compare your spending cap and wallet balance to spot low funds
Identify a frozen, closed, or expired card as a cause for declines
Choose the safest next step to fix or retry a payment

analogy.title: Your Patient Bank Teller Translator
analogy.story: Think of Muse Assistant like a patient bank teller who is also a translator. You hear confusing bank words like 'insufficient funds' and feel stuck. The teller listens to your question in plain English, looks at your receipt, and explains in calm, simple words what really happened. She does not judge, does not rush you, and points to your next safe step so you can fix it yourself with confidence.

mapping.everydayThing: patient bank teller who translates confusing bank words into plain words
confusing bank letter that is hard to understand alone
simple sticky note that says what happened and what to try next

pitch30Seconds: Ever had a payment declined and didn't know why? Muse Spark's Muse Assistant is here to help. Just open your history, tap any charge that didn't go through, and ask in your own words. It explains in plain, calm language if you hit a cap, had low balance, or used a frozen card, and shows your safest next step. No big bank words. No stress. Just clear answers so you can move forward.

coreIdeas.plainWords: The simple, honest cause behind a failed payment, like daily cap reached or card blocked, explained without bank jargon.
Your cap is your daily spending limit. Your wallet balance is actual money you have. A decline can happen from either one being too low.
A card that is locked for safety, shut down, or past its date will not work, even if you have money.
A calm, low-risk action to fix the issue, like trying a different card, adding funds, or checking with your provider.

howItWorks: Open Muse Assistant from your home screen.
Pick the charge or declined payment you want help with.
Ask about it in your own words, just like texting a friend.
Read the plain explanation of what happened and why.
Do the suggested safe fix, like use another card or add money.

recallQuiz.question: You try to pay $40 but you already spent your $100 daily cap. What happened?
choices: You hit your cap for today
recallQuiz.whyCorrect: You hit your daily spending limit, so new charges are blocked until tomorrow.

recallQuiz.question: Your card was locked after suspicious activity. Why was your payment declined?
recallQuiz.whyCorrect: A frozen card is locked for safety and cannot be charged until unlocked.

recallQuiz.question: Your wallet has $3 but your bill is $10. Why did it decline?
recallQuiz.whyCorrect: Your wallet balance is too low to cover the payment amount.

recallQuiz.question: Who can see your personal payment history in Muse Assistant?
choices: Only you, it is private and secured
recallQuiz.whyCorrect: Your history is private and row-level-secured so only you can see it.

safetyNote: Your history is private with row-level-secured history so only you can see it. Muse Assistant is in test-mode with no real money moves. It is mobile-first and works great on your phone. If you need real money help, contact your card provider.
tryIt: Open the Assistant screen, tap a declined payment, and type “Why was this declined?”
